title: 原dev readiness helper沿Source owner fail-closed與restore讀回
summary: Fixed stage_dev_paper_prerequisite_readiness in scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh along the natural Source owner authority contract without creating second entrypoints, wrappers, or leases. The helper now fails closed on connector read failures or unknown operator stop (refusing write/trigger), fails closed on prior schedule read failures, performs CAS conflict checks using admitted_updated_at, verifies restore PUT and actual owner GET readback, exits non-zero on restore failure, and enforces snapshot admissibility with mandatory event_time, future-date rejection, and fake checksum rejection.

counterexamples_eliminated.description: Temporary admission PUT succeeds, but restore PUT returns HTTP 500 or non-200. Previously exited 0 and printed 'readiness satisfied'. Fixed: helper verifies restore PUT status and body, checks GET readback, aborts on failure with exit 1, and never prints readiness satisfied.

Restore PUT returns 200, but owner GET readback shows enabled/interval was not actually restored to prior state. Fixed: verifies readback values match prior state, aborts on mismatch with exit 1, and never prints readiness satisfied.
Owner schedule updated_at changes after temporary admission. Fixed: CAS check detects updated_at mismatch before restore PUT, prevents overwriting external operator change, and exits 1.

Reading connector state returns HTTP non-200, malformed JSON, or connection failure. Previously treated unknown stop as not stopped and proceeded to write and trigger. Fixed: fail closed immediately, refuse refresh, zero PUT/POST calls.
Reading prior schedule returns HTTP non-200, malformed JSON, or interval <= 0. Previously defaulted to 'false 86400'. Fixed: fail closed immediately, refuse refresh, zero PUT/POST calls.
Temporary admission PUT returns HTTP non-200 or invalid body. Previously ignored and proceeded to trigger run-scheduled. Fixed: fail closed immediately, refuse trigger, zero POST calls.
Snapshot missing event_time was previously accepted if closes and market were present. Fixed: event_time is strictly mandatory.
Snapshot with future-dated event_time (age < 0) was previously accepted. Fixed: age < 0 rejected.
Snapshot where checksum matches snapshot_id was previously accepted. Fixed: checksum == snapshot_id rejected.
